Community Membership

Community Membership — $35/year

Renews annually until canceled · Secure billing through Stripe.

  • Richer reviewed profile content and practical business details
  • Reviewed paid cover/gallery media using current rights controls
  • Coupons, specials, sales, promotions and events with date/expiration support
  • Reviewed promotional graphics and image-based flyers
  • Qualified website and customer-action links
  • Eligibility for clearly labeled Community Member / Sponsored visibility in relevant Franklin discovery areas
Preview my member profile
Always free: claiming the basic profile, factual corrections, public-profile removal, legitimate free-profile management and approved basic profile photo/logo management after verified authority. Membership does not buy factual accuracy, ordinary unpaid ranking, endorsement, leads, customers, sales or guaranteed results.
Review, expiration and capability limits

Member promotional content is saved privately first and submitted for review. Only approved current items are shown publicly; expired, removed, unapproved or membership-ineligible items remain hidden. Current promotional media supports image-based graphics/flyers prepared as WebP. PDF coupon/flyer upload is not currently supported. No membership tool guarantees page views, search placement, traffic, leads, customers, calls, bookings, sales, revenue or event attendance.
